blast: medium — one new top-level spec node (conformance/), one new unshipped maintainer script + its package script, and a root spec.md placement-map registration (Capability map row, routing row, tie-break). No product code, no shipped surface, no frozen suite touched
novelty: medium — introduces a new node KIND to this corpus (a maintainer-only, unshipped, but behavioral tool that takes no cli/ mirror); the runner itself is conventional
approach: derive the adapter set from src/mux.<name>.ts and each adapter's suites from src/*.<name>.integration.test.ts, so a new adapter needs no runner edit
probe presence by PATH lookup of the adapter's own name — no per-adapter command table
separate five RUN outcomes (skip/gap/no-coverage/pass/fail) from three PROJECTED outcomes (skip/gap/runnable); the listing runs nothing and claims no run outcome
gap and no-coverage exit non-zero — a green exit that verified nothing is the failure mode the tool exists to prevent
skip exits 0; the listing reports suite presence for every adapter so a gap stays visible from a machine that cannot exercise it
adopt axi.md's exit-code set (0/1/2) so a bad invocation stays distinct from a failed verification

note: CR opened from a direct request (no source issue). Requester settled four forks: runner-only scope (shared injected conformance suite deferred to a follow-up CR), repo script not shipped, filesystem derivation over a registry, and installed-but-suiteless = non-zero exit.

Build-to-learn spike validated the load-bearing assumption behind the no-coverage outcome: with the tmux binary shimmed to fail, the tmux integration suite reports 6 collected / 0 passed / 0 failed / 6 skipped and vitest STILL exits 0 with success:true. Detection rule settled as passed+failed==0. Spike discarded.

Spec-judge round 1 blocked at governance pre-flight: the inline spec-producer forwarded an empty governances_loaded. Conductor error, not a producer skip — the seven resolved bars were then genuinely loaded and both artifacts reworked against them before re-judging.

Spec-judge round 2 failed builder+architect. Root cause of the two builder findings was one design defect: the listing form claimed to report 'the outcome a run would produce', but pass/fail/no-coverage are findings OF a run and are not statically derivable — contradicting that form's own before-committing-to-a-run purpose. Fixed by splitting run outcomes from projected outcomes (skip/gap/runnable) and drawing a P1-P3 projection sub-graph; the dead 'listing exits 0' edge was replaced with a discriminating companion that forces a projected gap. Also removed a phantom --help flag, and registered conformance/ in the root spec.md placement map (the architect finding).

note: Impl-judge surfaced that .agents/sdd/scenario-bridge.toml's command was scoped to `vitest run src`, so the conformance node's scenarios could never bind — a direct consequence of this CR placing the runner in the unshipped scripts/ dir rather than src/. Dropped the redundant `src` positional (the vitest config include already scopes the run); all 23 scenarios now bind through the bridge. Fixed in this CR rather than deferred, since the CR's own placement decision caused it.

verification: A cold impl-judge on a fresh context re-derived all 23 frozen scenarios' oracles independently and confirmed each bound it() verifies its own Then, including the two flagged for scrutiny (listing-projects-runnable's no-vitest-invocation clause is checked behaviorally against a recorded runs array, not by string matching; all-exits-nonzero drives all three Outline rows as distinct main() invocations). Structural read found no scope creep, an honest RunnerDeps seam, and main() returning an exit code faithful to the 'it exits N' scenarios. pnpm verify green 8/8 (1014 src + 10 dist tests, biome ci + typecheck clean). End-to-end on a tmux+herdr+wezterm box: listing exit 0, tmux pass 6 executed exit 0, wezterm gap exit 1, zellij skip exit 0, screen exit 2, bad flag exit 2 — and the decisive case, tmux shimmed on-PATH-but-broken, reports no-coverage (0 executed, 6 skipped) exit 1 where vitest alone exits 0.

note: wezterm and zellij ship adapters with mocked unit tests only and no real-boundary suite. The runner now reports this as a gap and exits non-zero on a machine where either is installed; writing those suites is the work that report exists to prompt.

The shared injected conformance suite: one SessionAdapter suite parameterized by adapter, so a new adapter inherits coverage and a new feature adds one scenario every adapter must satisfy. Deliberately deferred from this CR, which builds only the runner that would drive it.
Root spec.md's prose still describes the contract as spanning 'tmux, herdr, wezterm' while a zellij adapter ships and is specified in the agent node. Pre-existing drift, untouched by this CR.

--all's aggregation was verified by unit test only; it was deliberately not run end-to-end because doing so would drive the operator's live herdr server and create real workspaces. A hermetic herdr fixture would close the gap.
